title: Write the home cell
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number and let $z$ consist of a home cell containing an optional Boolean value, left and right lists of optional Boolean values indexed by $0,\ldots,\ell-1$, with each list at index $i$ having length at most $2\cdot 2^i$. Replacing the home cell by any chosen optional Boolean value leaves both families of lists unchanged.
